tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
Refer Tender document for detail specification of the product
The Authority reserves the right to accept or reject any or all tenders without assigning any reasons
Corrigendums / modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the website only. More details should be collected from the office at working hours
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP Portal.
Bidder has to quote rates including GST, Vehicle RTO Registration, insurance, other all Taxes & lead, lift and Transportation to work)
All the Work done certificate uploaded should include E-procurement indent number.
All terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: A list giving full particulars, including available sources and current prices, of spare parts, special tools, etc., necessary for the proper and continuing functioning of the goods for a period of two years, following commencement of the use of the goods by the Purchaser.

Item-by-item commentary on the Purchaser's Technical Specifications demonstrating substantial responsiveness of the goods and services to those specifications or a statement of deviations and exceptions to the provisions of the Technical Specifications.

Work Done Certificates for 76 HP EX 130 or Above Excavator Chain dozer work issued by officer equivalent and not below the rank of E E/Head of ULB and certified by any gazetted officer in any one of the last 3 Financial year (2023-24 to 2025-2026).
The Vehicle supplied should be provided with Authorized Service center within Kolar District Limit.
Tenderer should submit GST Registration Certificate and PAN Card.
The tenderer in its name should have in the last Three years i.e., 2023-24 to 2025-26 Achieved in at least Two financial years a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs.50.00 Lakhs.
